name: import_preview
description: Start importing a site into this one and get the plan without changing anything: pages found, old address -> new address, blocks of each page, what is lost (Zero Block, embeds, forms), redirects and menus. Source: url of a live site, or file_base64 with type wxr (WordPress Tools > Export XML) or tilda_zip (Tilda project export), up to 50 MB. Returns job_id; while status is analyzing call import_status again. Show the plan to the owner before import_apply. By default design is not moved, only content (mode blocks). Mode exact keeps the look of the source: it needs a capture package (type capture_zip, made on the owner's computer by tools/capture) that brings the pages of the source with their own styles, scripts and files; counters and chats are dropped. Administrators only.

file_base64.description: Export file in base64 instead of url

type.description: Kind of file_base64; capture_zip is a package made by tools/capture and always imports as an exact copy

limit.description: Most pages to take, default from the module settings (200)

conflict.description: When an address is taken on this site: suffix adds -2, skip leaves the page out. Default suffix

replace_home.description: Replace the content of the existing home page with the imported one. Default false

menus.description: Replace header and footer menus with the imported ones. Default true

section.description: Address of the section for blog posts, e.g. blog. Default: as at the source, or blog

mode.description: blocks (default for this skill): content goes into blocks of the active theme. exact: the page looks like the source; needs type capture_zip

details.description: Full blocks of every page in the answer
